custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১) Baelish said, “Long live King Joffrey!” (Change the narration.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Baelish said that King Joffrey to live long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Baelish wished the king, Joffrey, live long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Baelish wished that King Joffrey might live long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Baelish might wished that King Joffrey to live long.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Narration এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Optative sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে, Optative Sentence এর Direct form কে Indirect form এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- said এর পরিবর্তে wished / prayed বসবে।
- inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসবে।
- reported speech এর subject বসে + may/ might বসে
- reported verb এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত অংশ বসে।

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Direct Narration: Baelish said, “Long live King Joffrey!”
- Indirect Narration: Baelish wished that King Joffrey might live long.

More Examples:
- Direct Narration: He said, “Long live our unity!”
- Indirect Narration: He wished that their unity might live long.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question:
২) The scientist wrote a paper on the ____ of life on Earth. 
Fill in the blanks using the correct word:
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: exodus
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: genesis
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: apocalypse
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: epilogue
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Genesis (noun)
- English Meaning: the origin or coming into being of something.
- Bangla Meaning: সূচনা; প্রারম্ভিক বিন্দু।

Complete Sentence: The scientist wrote a paper on the genesis of life on Earth.

Other Options:
ক) exodus - বহুলোকের একত্রে বহির্গমন; অভিনিষ্ক্রমণ। 

গ) apocalypse - বিশেষত ঈশ্বরলব্ধ জ্ঞানের প্রকাশ। 

ঘ) epilogue - সাহিত্যকর্মের সমাপ্তি অংশ; নাটক শেষে দর্শকের উদ্দেশ্যে অভিনেতার বিশেষ সংলাপ।

ঙ) economical - মিতব্যয়ী; হিসাবি।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary, Cambridge Dictionary.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question:
৩) The scientist said, “The earth moves around the sun.” 
Change the narration:
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: The scientist said that the earth moves around the sun.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: The scientist said that the sun is moved around by the earth.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: The scientist said that the sun might be moving around by the earth.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: The scientist said that the earth moves around.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Narration এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Reported speech দ্বারা যদি কোনো চিরন্তন সত্য বা অভ্যাসগত কর্ম বা ঐতিহাসিক সত্য বা বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য প্রকাশ পায়, তবে Indirect Narration এ Tense এর কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না৷
- Reporting verb এর subject এবং verb অপরিবর্তিত ভাবে বসে।
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসে।
- বাকি অংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

• অর্থাৎ, নিয়মানুযায়ী,
Direct Narration: The scientist said, “The earth moves around the sun.”
Indirect Narration: The scientist said that the earth moves around the sun.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৪) Select the synonym of the word 'gullible.'
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Cynical
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Skeptical
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Naive
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Suspicious
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Gullible (adjective)
English Meaning: easily duped or cheated.
Bangla Meaning: সহজে প্রতারণাযোগ্য।

Synonyms:
• Naive – সরল, সাদাসিধে, অকপট।
• Trusting - অপরকে বিশ্বাস করিতে উন্মুখ।
• Susceptible – গ্রহণশীল, সহজগ্রাহী।

Antonyms:      
• Cynical – নৈরাশ্যবাদীর, আচরণসম্পন্ন।
• Skeptical – সন্দেহপ্রবণ।
• Suspicious - সন্দেহজনক।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary, Cambridge Dictionary.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৫) Change the voice: I heard her singing a song.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: She was heard of singing a song.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: I was heard her singing a song.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: She heard singing a song by me.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: She was heard singing a song by me.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Active Voice: I heard her singing a song.
Passive Voice: She was heard singing a song by me.

• Object + present participle যুক্ত active voice কে passive voice এ পরিবর্তনের সময়-
• object টি Subject হয় + Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb বসে + মূল verb-এর past participle বসে + present participle যুক্ত অংশটি বসে + by বসে + Subjectটির objective form বসে।

অর্থাৎ, 
-  present participle থেকে বাক্যের বাকি অংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
- এক্ষেত্রে শুধু present participle এর পূর্ববর্তী বাক্যাংশের passive form হয়ে থাকে।
- আর, By+ object যুক্ত অংশ বাক্যের শেষে বসে।

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৬) What is the antonym of the word 'handy'?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: convenient
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Inaccessible
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: adjacent
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: skilled
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Handy (adjective)
- English Meaning: conveniently near. convenient for use of a ship : easily handled. clever in using the hands especially in a variety of useful ways
- Bangla Meaning: (১) (ব্যক্তি) হাতের কাজে পটু; কুশলী।
(২) (বস্তু, স্থান) সুবিধাজনক; দরকারি: কোন একসময় কাজে লাগা: 
(৩) বেশি দূরে নয়; হাতের কাছে; ব্যবহারের জন্য মেলে এমন।

• Synonyms:
• Convenient - সুবিধাজনক।
• Accessible – অভিগম্য, কোনো কিছুর দ্বারা প্রভাবিত করার উপযোগী।
• Adjacent – সন্নিহিত।
• Skilled – দক্ষ, পটু।

• Antonyms:
• Capable – শক্তিমান, সক্ষম, শক্তিধর।
• Inconvenient – বিড়ম্বনাকর, অসুবিধাজনক।
• Inaccessible – অগম্য।
• Unhandy - ছাড়িয়া দেত্তয়া, হাত ছেড়ে দেওয়া।
• Uncomfortable - অস্বস্তিকর।

Other Options:
• conclusion - উপসংহার।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary, Cambridge Dictionary.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৭) Don’t neglect your duties. (Change the voice.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Let your duties not be neglected.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Let your duties be neglected.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Let not your duties be neglected.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Let not your duties neglected.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Imperative Sentence কে Active Voice থেকে Passive Voice এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম:

এক্ষেত্রে,
• Do not দিয়ে শুরু যুক্ত Imperative Sentence এর Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ রূপান্তরিত করার নিয়ম:
-  প্রথমে Let not বসে, 
- Objectটি subject রূপে বসে, 
- be বসে, 
- মূল Verb-এর Past Participle বসে।

সে অনুসারে, 
Active Voice: Don’t neglect your duties.
Passive Voice: Let not your duties be neglected.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৮) Select the synonym of the word 'haphazard.'
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: systematic
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: stable
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: regular
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: sporadic
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Haphazard (adjective, noun)
- English Meaning: marked by lack of plan, order, or direction.
- Bangla Meaning: পরিকল্পনাহীন, এলোপাতাড়ি।

Synonyms:
• Random -এলোমেলোভাবে।
• Sporadic - বিক্ষিপ্ত।
• Scattered - ছড়ানো। 

Antonyms:
• Systematic - সুশৃঙ্খল।
• Systematically - ক্রমপরম্পরায়।
• Stable - দৃঢ়।      
• Regular - সমভাবে বিন্যস্ত।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary, Cambridge Dictionary.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৯) Karim wants to become a doctor. (Make it complex.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Karim want that he will become a doctor.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Karim wants that he will become a doctor.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Karim wanted that he would become a doctor.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Karim wanted that he will become a doctor.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• To + Verb - Object বা Object সদৃশ হলে Complex Sentence এ that + Clause বসে।
এখানে To + Verb টি a doctor - Noun এর অনন্তর্নিহিত Verb এর Object সদৃশ হয়েছে।

- মূল Clause এর Verb (wants) present Tense হওয়ায়, এ Clause টাও present Tense এ হবে।
- তবে to + verb সাধারণত Future Indicate করে, তাই এখানে Future (will) হবে। 
- তবে মনে রাখতে হবে, to + verb  যদি উদ্দেশ্য বুঝানোর জন্য আসে, তখন সাধারণত so that বা in order that যুক্ত Clause বসে।

- Simple Sentence: Karim wants to become a doctor.
- Complex Sentence: Karim wants that he will become a doctor.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১০) Select the correct spelling:
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Hommogeneous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Homoganeous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Homogeneous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Homiogeneous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Correct Spelling: Homogeneous.

• Homogeneous (adjective)
- English Meaning: Consisting of parts or having qualities that are the same.
- Bangla Meaning: সমপ্রকৃতির অংশসমূহ নিয়ে গঠিত; সমজাতীয়; সমজাতিক; সমঘন; সমমাত্র।

Example Sentence:
- If all jobs and workers were homogeneous.
- At the beginning of the experiments, seedlings were homogeneous in terms of length.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১১) Study hard or fail the exam. (Make it Simple.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: By studying hard, you will fail the exam.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Studying hard, you will fail the exam.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Without studying hard, you will fail the exam.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Without studying hard, you failed the exam.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Compound Sentence: Study hard or fail the exam.
Simple Sentence: Without studying hard, you will fail the exam.
 
• Or যুক্ত Compound Sentence কে Simple করার নিয়ম:

- প্রথমে Without বসে + প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb এর সাথে ing যোগ হয় + verb এর পরের অংশ বসে (যদি থাকে) + or এর পরিবর্তে (,) বসে + দ্বিতীয় বাক্য/বাক্যাংশ বসে। 
- এখানে দ্বিতীয় বাক্যে শুধু "regret it later" আছে বিধায় এটি future tense এ হবে। 

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১২) Select the correct spelling:
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Horrenndous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Horiendous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Horendous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Horrendous
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Horrendous:
- English Meaning: extremely bad or unpleasant : horrible, dreadful 
- Bangla Meaning: পৈশাচিক; ভয়াবহ; বীভৎস; ভয়ংকর; নিদারুণ; ভীষণ।

Example Sentences:
- We see some terrible cases but this is the most horrendous for some time.
- The drive home was horrendous, with repeated hold-ups and long, long tailbacks.
 
Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary, Cambridge Dictionary.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৩) The tiger is one of the fiercest animals in the jungle. (Make it comparative degree.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: The tiger is fierce than other animals in the jungle.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: The tiger is fiercer than any other animals in the jungle.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: The tiger is fiercer than most other animals in the jungle.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: The tiger is fierce than most other animals in the jungle.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Degree এর ক্ষেত্রে,
• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রুপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
Subject + verb + Superlative এর comparative form + than most other + প্রদত্ত sentence এর বাকি অংশ।

Superlative degree: The tiger is one of the fiercest animals in the jungle.
Comparative degree: The tiger is fiercer than most other animals in the jungle.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৪) What is the most precise meaning of the word "Iconoclast"?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: A devout follower of religious icons
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: A leader who unites different ideological factions
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: A person who seeks to overthrow established traditions and beliefs
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: A scholar who specializes in ancient scripts
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option5: A sculptor who carves religious figures
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• The required answer is - A person who seeks to overthrow established traditions and beliefs.

• Iconoclast (noun)
English Meaning: a person who challenges or seeks to overthrow established traditions, beliefs, or institutions, especially religious or societal norms.
Bangla Meaning: সংস্কারবিরোধী; প্রতিমাভঙ্গকারী।

Example Sentence:
- The iconoclast writer gained fame for criticizing long-held cultural traditions.
- Throughout history, many scientific breakthroughs were driven by iconoclasts who questioned conventional wisdom.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৫) The bag is so heavy that I cannot lift it. (Make it simple.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: The bag is so heavy for me to lift.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: The bag is heavy for me to lift.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: The bag is too heavy for me to lift.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: The bag is heavy, and I cannot lift it.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• So ___  that যুক্ত complex sentence কে, simple করার সময় নিম্নোক্ত structure প্রযোজ্য হয় -
- So এর স্থানে too বসে, that এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত আর কোন পরিবর্তন হোয় না।
- that থেকে not পর্যন্ত উঠে যায়। 
- to বসে এবং sentence এর বাকি অংশ বসে।

Complex Sentence: The bag is so heavy that I cannot lift it.
Simple Sentence: The bag is too heavy for me to lift.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question:
১৬) In the office, his indolent attitude toward deadlines frustrated both his manager and teammates.
Select the antonym of the word indolent.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: Proactive
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: Inactive
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: Detached
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: Tired
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Indolent (adjective)
English Meaning: habitually lazy or avoiding work; avoiding exertion.
Bangla Meaning: অলস; নিশ্চেষ্ট; নিরুদ্যম; নিরুদ্যোগী; পরিশ্রমবিমুখ।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Proactive - সক্রিয়; অগ্রগামী; উদ্যোগী।

- Inactive - নিষ্ক্রিয়; কাজহীন।

- Detached - বিচ্ছিন্ন; অজ্ঞাত; আড্ডাহীন।

- Tired - ক্লান্ত; অবসন্ন; অবস্থা যেখানে শরীর বা মন শক্তিহীন।

- Slow-moving - ধীরগতি; খুব ধীর গতিতে চলা।

- Option বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায়, Indolent এর সঠিক antonym হচ্ছে Proactive.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৭) Having finished his homework, he went out to play. (Make it Complex.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: When he finishes his homework, he went out to play.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: When he finished his homework, he went out to play.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: When he finished his homework, he went to play.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: When he had finished his homework, he went out to play.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Simple to Complex:
Simple Sentence: Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
Complex Sentence: When he had finished his homework, he went out to play.

Structure:
• Simple Sentence to Complex Sentence: (Having + Verb এর past participle form যুক্ত)
• Structure: Having এর পরিবর্তে When বসে + Subject + had + Verb এর past participle form + বাকী অংশ।

Simple Sentence: Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
Complex Sentence: When he had finished his homework, he went out to play.

• এ জাতীয় আরোও একটি উদাহরণ - 
- Simple: Having told this, he went away.
- Complex: When he had told he went away.

- Simple: Having done this, he went away.
- Complex: When he had done this he went away.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৮) The ________ of their love was found in the silence between their words.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: idiosyncrase
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: idiosyncrasy
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: idiosyncrasey
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: idiosyncracy
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
• Complete Sentence: The idiosyncrasy of their love was found in the silence between their words.

• Idiosyncrasy (noun)
English meaning: a strange or unusual habit, way of behaving, or feature that someone or something has.
Bangla meaning: ব্যক্তির বিশিষ্ট চিন্তারীতি বা আচরণ; স্বভাব বৈশিষ্ট্য 

Example: 
- She often cracks her knuckles when she's speaking - it's one of her little idiosyncrasies.
- One of the idiosyncrasies of this printer is that you can't stop it once it has started.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৯) Because of her carelessness, she lost her wallet. (Transform to complex sentence.)
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option1: As she was careless, she lose her wallet.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option2: As she was careless, she lost her wallet.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option3: As she is careless, she lost her wallet.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.option4: As her being careless, she lost her wallet.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Simple Sentence: Because of her carelessness, she lost her wallet.
Complex Sentence: As she was careless, she lost her wallet.

• Because of যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex-এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Simple sentence এ because of থাকলে Complex sentence এর পরিবর্তে Since/ as ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- তারপর  Subject বসে + Verb বসে,
- এরপর Adjective /Noun + Comma বসে,
- সবশেষে অপর clause টি বসে।

More example: 
Simple: Because of my illness, I could not attend the meeting.
Complex: Since I was ill, I could not attend the meeting.
